{{Quote|Boss, there's no way we can get this thing out of drydock in ten cycles. We'd need the engine yesterday, and it's still on the way from Nimban.|A memo concerning the ''Ossic Hand'' found at the Orinda Dockyards|<ref name="ZC">''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]''</ref>}}
'''Nimban''' was a [[Hutt Space]] [[planet]] situated on the [[Pabol Sleheyron]] and [[Sisar Run]] [[hyperspace route]]s. It was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Nimbanel]] [[species]]. In [[19 BBY]], an [[engine]] was being delivered to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] ''[[Ossic Hand]]'' while it was undergoing routine maintenance at the [[Mid Rim Territories]] world [[Orinda]].

==Description==
Nimban was a terrestrial<ref name="AlienArchive" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> located in the [[Nimban system]],<ref name="Appendix" /> a part of the [[Hutt Space]] portion of<ref name="Timelines" /> [[the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> Situated in grid square S-10 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was linked by<ref name="Timelines" /> the [[Pabol Sleheyron]] [[hyperspace route]] to the [[Chalacta system|Chalacta]] and [[Sleheyron system]]s<ref name="Guide" /> while the [[Sisar Run]]<ref name="Sisar" /> hyperlane connected it to the [[Sionia system]].<ref name="Guide" />

==History==
[[File:OssicHandHologram-ZeroCompany.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Ossic Hand'' (hologram pictured) awaited an engine from Nimban while docked at Orinda during the Clone Wars.]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ZCdate">{{ZeroCompanyDate|republic=1|the mention of Nimban}}</ref> while the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] ''[[Ossic Hand]]'' was undergoing routine maintenance at the [[Orinda Dockyards]] of<ref name="ZC" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix Orinda">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Orinda system]]</ref> world<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> [[Orinda]], it awaited the delivery of an [[engine]] from Nimban. The expected delivery was noted in a memo that was at one point stored on a [[datapad]] found at the [[Shipyard|docking bay]].<ref name="ZC" />

At some point, Nimban was mentioned in an entry of an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]] dedicated to the celestial body's native [[Nimbanel]] [[species]]. The entry was included in a section of the [[Book|work]] describing [[Sentience|sentient]] species that originated in dry habitats. The journal was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="AlienArchive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Nimban was the [[homeworld]] of the sentient Nimbanel species,<ref name="AlienArchive" /> including [[Mosep Binneed]], a servant of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Geektionary" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SW-Geektionary-Cover.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Nimban was first described in the current ''Star Wars'' canon in ''Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z''.]]
Nimban's name was first mentioned in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], a [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' boxed set.<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> It was then identified as a distinct planet in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''.<ref name="Geektionary" />

[[Nimban/Legends|Nimban]] was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> "Meet the Hutts: The Galaxy's Biggest Crime Lords," a canon video in the ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy Guide]]'' series published on the official ''Star Wars'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[September 16]], [[2026]], reused a map noting Nimban<ref name="YouTube">{{SWYouTube|series=Star Wars: Galaxy Guide|text=Meet the Hutts: The Galaxy's Biggest Crime Lords|video=Ct977noXUVg}}</ref> created by the artist [[Modi]] that originated in the ''Star Wars'' Legends reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
